_about: Every public-domain John Calvin (1509-1564) English text the Word Hoard holds beyond the Commentaries. The 45 Calvin Translation Society commentary volumes are already held through CALVIN_COMMENTARIES in pipeline/fetch_sources.py (census 2026-10-02: complete, Genesis to the Catholic Epistles; Calvin wrote no commentary on Revelation and his Ezekiel stops at ch. 20), listed under _held. Added here as verified gaps: the Institutes in Henry Beveridge's Calvin Translation Society translation (1845) and A Treatise on Relics (tr. Krasinski, 1854), clean from CCEL; the Letters (ed. Jules Bonnet, Philadelphia: Presbyterian Board of Publication, 1858), vols. 1-2 clean from Gutenberg and vols. 3-4 as IA OCR; and the Tracts Relating to the Reformation (Calvin Translation Society, tr. Beveridge, 1844-1851, 3 vols; title-page years read from the OCR) as IA OCR, raw and unconverted. Extended 2026-10-24 by lane A at Adam's request (his Libronix list: all of Calvin in public-domain English) with the sixteenth-century English translations the Calvin Translation Society never reached or that differ from it: Thomas Norton's Institution (1561), the Geneva catechism in English, the treatises on the sacrament, on relics, against astrology, and on the immortality of the soul, and the sermon translations of Arthur Golding and others (on Job, Deuteronomy, Galatians, Ephesians, Timothy and Titus, the Ten Commandments, Psalm 119, Jacob and Esau, Melchizedek, Jonah, and single sermons). The early English versions of the commentaries are left out, since the Calvin Translation Society set holds every commentary.

_excluded.CCEL calvin/institutio1, institutio2: Latin Institutio (1834): CCEL's files are stubs, about 4,000 characters each
_excluded.CCEL calvin/sermons: 'Three Volumes of Sermons' is Corpus Reformatorum vols. 61-63, the French originals: not the CTS English this shelf collects (a later French/Latin shelf could take it)
_excluded.calvin-early-commentaries: the sixteenth- and seventeenth-century English versions of the commentaries (Psalms 1571, Genesis 1578, Corinthians 1577, Colossians 1581, Romans 1583, Hebrews 1605, Isaiah 1609 and others): every commentary is held in the Calvin Translation Society translation
_excluded.calvin-latin-other: Latin, Spanish and Irish editions; the 1597 Geneva New Testament
_excluded.calvin-abridgements: the Abridgement of the Institution (Lawne, 1585-87) and the Aphorismi: made by others
_excluded.calvin-about: books about Calvin or Calvinism (The Ruine of Calvinisme, A Vindication of Calvin, Calvinus Redivivus, Vindiciae Calvinisticae, modern studies)
_excluded.calvin-dups: later printings of the Catechism (1560-1628), the second scans of the Job, Deuteronomy and Four Sermons volumes, and the 1580 Lectures of Sermons
_excluded.bim_early-english-books-1475-1640_whethe: Whether Christian Faith May Be Kept Secret (1553): the text file is under 5 KB, unusable OCR
